integrity.caption: Review-integrity constraints (the ones AI content systems break first)

rows.constraint: Customer reviews created, edited or removed in exchange for compensation are prohibited — Amazon's Community Guidelines are incorporated into the Operating Agreement
rows.consequence: Breach of the Agreement; the compensation rule also covers incentivised review swapping, not just cash.

rows.constraint: Do not display or use Amazon customer reviews or star ratings in part or whole unless the link to that review/rating was obtained through Creators API or PA API under the License
rows.consequence: Disqualified purchases and material-breach exposure. The site therefore stores no review bodies.

rows.constraint: Do not post Special Links in any content placed on an Amazon Site, including a customer review, forum, Wish List or guide
rows.consequence: Zero attributed revenue from that surface plus account risk. No Amazon-side publishing module exists.

rows.constraint: No consideration, reward or incentive (money, rebate, discount, points, donation) for using Special Links
rows.consequence: Disqualification. Rules out 'leave a review and get X' growth loops entirely.

rows.constraint: Do not purchase products through your own Special Links, or ask/permit relatives, employees, contractors or business relations to
rows.consequence: Treated as abuse; the affiliate also may not offer listed products for resale or commercial use.

rows.constraint: FTC: endorsements must reflect the honest opinions of the endorser and each undisclosed endorsement could be deceptive
rows.consequence: Regulatory exposure independent of Amazon. This site publishes no testimonial content of any kind.

rows.constraint: Do not misrepresent, embellish or imply Amazon endorsement of you or your site
rows.consequence: Material breach. 'Amazon's #1 rated' style framing is banned in the copy linter.

rows.does: Read review aggregate fields returned by Creators API GetItems for the ASIN
Derive a review-velocity and rating-distribution signal for the ranking model
Never persist or republish review bodies; never train a model on Program Content
Show an aggregate score with an "as of" stamp and a link to the live listing, so the reader reads the reviews at source
